name: One version
description: One VERSION of one model, by id -- what GET /v1/models/{id} answered before an entry and a version became different things. It is a permalink and stays public: a rating nobody can audit is not a rating. The successor is THE SAME ENTRY'S next version, in the same season, which is the only reading that is true now that a competitor holds several models: scoped by owner it would name a sibling entry's version and tell someone their v3 was replaced by a v7 belonging to a different model of theirs. `class_max_bytes` comes from the version's own season, because a cap is the season's and a closed season's standing cannot be read against today's table.
